meta_title: New Pin Locksmiths | Emergency Locksmith Leeds
meta_description: New Pin Locksmiths Leeds offers emergency locksmith services, lock repairs, and key cutting. Fast response times, 24/7 available. Call us now.
hero_subhead: We arrive in under 30 minutes. Broken locks, lost keys, or emergency access — call us anytime, day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to routine maintenance, we handle every lock problem fast and fairly.

services.title: Emergency Lock-Outs
services.desc: Trapped outside? We'll get you back in without damage to your door or frame. Fast, professional entry in under 30 minutes most areas.

services.title: Lock Repairs & Replacements
services.desc: Broken locks, worn cylinders, or damaged mechanisms fixed on the spot. We carry common lock types on the van for immediate replacement.

services.title: Key Cutting
services.desc: Spare keys cut while you wait, from house keys to vehicle and security keys. No appointment needed.

services.title: UPVC Door & Window Locks
services.desc: Repair or replace faulty uPVC mechanism locks and handles. Keep your home secure and your doors operating smoothly.

services.title: Commercial & Business Locksmith
services.desc: Office lock-outs, rekeying, access control upgrades, and master key systems for Leeds businesses and landlords.

services.title: Lock Upgrades & Security
services.desc: Upgrade to anti-snap or BS3621 approved locks for better home security. Professional fitting with advice tailored to your property.

about_pullquote: I started New Pin because being locked out shouldn't cost a fortune or take hours.
about_para_1: New Pin Locksmiths has been serving Leeds residents and businesses for over a decade. Founded on the principle of honest pricing and rapid response, we've built our reputation one satisfied customer at a time. Whether it's 3am on a Sunday or mid-afternoon on a weekday, our team is ready to help.
about_para_2: We're not a call centre that passes you to the cheapest contractor. You'll speak to a qualified locksmith who knows Leeds, understands the job, and gives you a fair quote before we start work. Most customers return because we treat their home security seriously and our vans are fully stocked to fix problems first time.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked myself out on a Friday night with no way to get the spare key. Called New Pin at 9pm and the lad was here by 9:40. Sorted it in five minutes, no damage, and the price was spot on. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Our office lock was jammed and we couldn't get in Monday morning. They came out within the hour, fixed it properly, and didn't charge us a fortune like some places do. Will definitely call them again.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Had a broken window lock and needed it sorted before the weekend. Very professional, explained what needed doing, and the job was done well. Fair price too. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: James P.
